description: Write a file in a sandbox, replacing it whole if it exists; missing parent directories are created. Content is UTF-8 text, or base64 with encoding "base64"; up to 100 MiB. Paths are absolute under /home/prized, or relative to /home/prized/work.

content.description: The file content: text, or base64 when encoding is "base64".

path.description: Where to write: /home/prized/work/app.py, or app.py (relative to /home/prized/work).

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox id (sbx_...), from create_sandbox or list_sandboxes.

name: write_file
title: Write a file in a sandbox
